note: Which fn Mini runs against. Mini >= lane/plat-fn-frames (fn frames!) requires an fn with --frame on identity, status, position, ack and poll; the production image has none, and Mini refuses it by name (Host/Main fnNoFrameError). Production deploy waits for fn's converged image; re-pin `production` to it (one line) when fn sends its sha.

production.use: production deploys (none of Mini >= fn frames until fn's converged image)
